It manufactures and sells metal compounds such as copper, tin, nickel and cobalt, metal soaps such as octylic acid, battery chemicals, surface-treatment brighteners and additives, and electroless nickel plating solutions, and carries out contract processing of cathode materials for secondary batteries. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥24,136 million. The company manufactures and sells the products, and the consolidated subsidiary Siam NKS CO.,LTD. manufactures and sells industrial chemicals in Thailand.
